contact.cta: Secure Every Door. Explore the Tenacity Collection.

collections.title: Internal Door Locks
collections.intro: Locks for bedrooms, bathrooms and other interior doors, from budget-friendly offers to premium rose-handle designs.

sections.title: TM53 Series — Entry-Level Internal Door Locks
sections.copy: Practical, budget-friendly door locks for interior spaces, available in bathroom/privacy (keyless) and keyed-access configurations, in four finishes.
sections.quote: For internal door locks on OFFER (with keys and bathroom options) we have the TM53 series entry level door locks.
facts: Keyless bathroom or keys both sides

sections.title: Premium Quality Internal Door Locks
sections.copy: A selection of premium-quality internal door hardware with refined finishes and different access configurations: an executive knob-and-key lock and single-pin or 3-pin locks with modern rose handles.
sections.quote: We also have the Premium Quality internal door locks as per the below photos.

collections.title: Main Door & Steel Door Locks
collections.intro: Tenacity offers main-door and steel-door locks ranging from affordable entry-level units to heavy-duty, multiple-bolt and premium stainless steel security systems. Choose the category that matches the door material, use case and required key configuration.

sections.title: Tenacity Entry-Level Locks
sections.copy: An economical lock option with three normal brass keys, intended for light-duty steel and light-duty solid wooden doors.
sections.quote: They come with 3 normal brass keys and are ideal for both Light Duty Steel and Light Duty Solid wooden doors.

sections.title: Tenacity Single-Pin with Normal Keys
sections.copy: Single-bolt locks with a fully solid zinc bolt and premium Tenacity handles, built for steel doors and heavy-duty wooden doors.
sections.quote: They come with 3 brass normal keys, 1 fully SOLID ZINC bolt and Premium Tenacity handles. They are ideal for both Steel doors and Heavy-duty wooden door locks.

sections.title: Tenacity 3-Pin with Dimple Keys
sections.copy: Three fully solid brass bolts and five brass dimple keys for a stronger locking point on steel and heavy-duty wooden doors.
sections.quote: They come with 5 brass dimple keys, 3 fully solid brass bolts and Premium Tenacity handles. They are ideal for both Steel doors and Heavy-duty wooden door locks.

sections.title: F6 Series
sections.copy: Medium-sized, heavy-duty locks with steel 3-pin bolts and five brass keys described by the supplier as non-duplicatable.
sections.quote: They are medium sized locks with steel 3-PIN bolts and 5 non-duplicatable keys made from brass. They are heavy duty and ideal for both Steel doors and Heavy-duty wooden door locks.

sections.title: Tenacity Rose Handles with 4-Pin & Non-Duplicatable Keys
sections.copy: Four solid zinc bolts paired with modern rose handles — a clean, contemporary look with main-door strength.
sections.quote: They come with 5 brass non-duplicatable keys, 4 fully solid zinc bolts and Premium Tenacity handles. They are ideal for both Steel doors and Heavy-duty wooden door locks.

sections.title: Tenacity 4-Pin with Non-Duplicatable Keys
sections.copy: Four-bolt locks with a full brass 70 mm cylinder and 2-in-1 double-serrated keys, in a wide choice of handle styles and finishes.
sections.quote: They come with 5 brass non-duplicatable keys, 4 fully solid zinc bolts and Premium Tenacity handles. They are ideal for both Steel doors and Heavy-duty wooden door locks.

sections.title: Premium SUS 304 Stainless Steel Mortice Lock
sections.copy: The Tenacity Premium SUS 304 Stainless Steel Mortice Lock is designed for customers seeking long-term reliability and superior security. According to the supplier, the lock case, internal mechanisms, springs and screws are SUS 304 stainless steel for resistance to rust and wear, with heavy-duty zinc handles for a solid premium feel.
sections.quote: Designed for steel doors and heavy-duty wooden doors, this range is backed by a lifetime guarantee.
facts: SUS 304 stainless steel lock case & mechanism

collections.title: Deadlocks
collections.intro: Add a dedicated locking point to any door. Choose by how the lock engages when the door closes.

sections.title: Non-Latching Deadlocks
sections.copy: Manually operated deadlocks that do not lock automatically when the door closes. Use the key to engage the locking bolt.
sections.quote: We have the non-latching deadlocks (it does not lock automatically you have to use the key to lock).

sections.title: Auto-Latching Deadlocks
sections.copy: Automatic-latching deadlocks whose mechanism engages when the door shuts. Correct installation remains essential.
sections.quote: We also have the Auto-latching deadlocks (it locks automatically once banged).
facts: Locks automatically when the door shuts

sections.title: Ball-Catch Deadlocks
sections.copy: A hybrid between non-latching and auto-latching deadlocks. The ball catch holds the door closed when it shuts; if the lower bolt is not locked, the door can be pushed or pulled open without a key. Turn the key to engage the main bolt when full locking is needed.
sections.quote: A hybrid solution between non-latching and auto-latching deadlocks.

collections.title: Door Hardware & Accessories
collections.intro: Pull handles, push and pull plates, bathroom sets and replacement cylinders.

sections.title: Door Pullers
sections.copy: Door pull handles and push/pull plates for a range of entrance designs. Handle sizes are listed with their individual prices.

sections.title: Bathroom Sets
sections.copy: Bathroom accessory sets in three series (7500, 7600, 7800) and AB, GP and SN finishes. Set contents are as pictured.

sections.title: Cylinders
sections.copy: Replacement and longer door lock cylinders. Standard lock packages include a 70 mm cylinder; for doors wider than 2 inches, choose an 80 mm, 90 mm or 100 mm cylinder. The included 70 mm cylinder cannot be exchanged or traded in.

collections.title: Padlocks
collections.intro: Brass padlocks from budget to Italian-made, for gates, stores and shutters.

sections.title: Tri-Circle Padlocks
sections.copy: Brass Tri-Circle padlocks in four sizes, priced from the shelf labels.

sections.title: Mindy Padlocks
sections.copy: Mindy anti-theft padlocks in 40, 50 and 60 mm, with or without a shackle guard.

sections.title: Viro Padlocks
sections.copy: Italian-made Viro padlocks with normal or patented keys, in key-retaining and non-key-retaining versions.
